label: VexWork Operational Console Evolution
purpose: Evolve VexWork from a Project/Work Board navigator into a reusable console that can derive work-shaped attention from dynamic entity populations and operating environments without turning every entity, event, or provider record into a Work item; prove the abstraction first with VexSite Localization, then generalize it through an online antique-plate commerce pilot that reaches a human physical-fulfillment acknowledgement.
